title.narrative: Honduras Education Quality, Governance, & Institutional Strengthening

description.narrative: Specifically, the Project's Development Objectives are to: (i) expand pre-school coverage in disadvantaged communities; (ii) improve completion rates in Proyecto de Educacion Comunitaria (PROHECO) schools; (iii) improve teacher accountability; and (iv) improve accountability of schools to citizens. There are 4 components to the Project: Component 1. Enhancing and Scaling-Up Interventions that Address the Education Needs of the Poor. This component will support pre and primary school level interventions focused on the poorest segments of the population. Component 2. Community Participation in School Management for Better Performance. This component would foster community participation within an Integrated School Management System with the objective of improving the quality of education. Component 3. Governance and Institutional Strengthening the Ministry of Education (MoE). This component would support efforts to strengthen the MoE, including improving governance and management capacity. Component 4. Project Administration. This component would finance technical personal and operating costs.
The objective of the Project is to support the Recipient to increase the coverage, quality, accountability and governance of its basic education system.

condition.narrative: Requires depositing the entire amount of fundsIDA-financed and counterpart, into the newly established pension fund for PROHECOteachers.

Requires the Government to amend the PROHECO Debt Payment Agreement, in a manner satisfactory to the Association, to establish theamount of the debt that the Government of Honduras, through SEFIN, shall pay to INPREMA accounting for the specific entitlements ofeach PROHECO teacher employed from March 1, 1999 to January 31, 2012.

Requires the Government to determine the entitlements for each PROHECO teacher with respects to the pension payments that suchteacher and the employer have made since March 1, 1999, all in a manner satisfactory to the Association.
Requires the Government to identify each individual PROHECO teacher who is entitled to pension funds and the amount owed to eachteacher.
Requires the Governmente to establish an acceptable pension fund for PROHECO teachers.

The Government of Honduras, through SEFIN and SEDUC, shall exercise its rights and carry out its obligations under the PROHECOAffiliation Agreement and the PROHECO Debt Payment Agreement, in a manner satisfactory to the Assocation.
